name: ANR Northwoods Project
researcher_notes: Not an existing row. Checked ANR rows: Wisconsin Reliability (P5547, 48 mi, operating, different project) and Heartland (P7793, Illinois to Wisconsin, 70 mi, proposed) are separate. Northwoods is a 92 mile, 36 inch loop along ANR's mainline in Iron County, Michigan and Florence, Marinette, Oconto and Shawano Counties, Wisconsin, plus one new 4,700 horsepower compressor station in Shawano County and two meter stations. Concrete step: ANR entered FERC pre-filing on March 12, 2026 (docket PF26-6); formal application planned October 2026, certificate October 2027, in service November 1, 2029. Source is the EIA pipeline projects table for August 2026 (sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, Excel row 94, project Northwoods Project, status Pre-applied, 92 mi, 36 in, 390 MMcf/d, 2029, 390,000 Dth/d in the description). The TC Energy project page states about 92 miles, Michigan and Wisconsin, 2029, and about 0.4 Bcf/d. TC Energy page and EIA table both trace to the operator, so they count as one origin and the tier is medium. The 36 inch diameter is stated only in the EIA table. A May 2025 trade press item says the project was approved, with a headline of 900 MM; the currency is not clear, so no cost was staged and no final investment decision flag was set. An October 2025 trade press item (pgjonline) did not contain the project name text on the checked pages and is not cited. Owner is shown in the roster style 'ANR Pipeline Co'; parent TC Energy per the project page, left to the ownership team. Route: no official GIS found; staged as no route, to be researched in a routes pass. Suggested next step: pair with the FERC pre-filing docket PF26-6 documents when cheap.
